name: Shop Menu Agent
description: Разбор меню в JSON с crop фото. Чат/WorkItem import: read_file(page_summarizations + summarization_schema / submit_page_summary) → materialize.

route_entry.name: Route chat or WorkItem
route_entry.code:
WORK_ITEM_CONTEXT_PREFIX = "work_item:"


async def run(args, state):
    context_id = state.get("context_id")
    if isinstance(context_id, str) and context_id.startswith(WORK_ITEM_CONTEXT_PREFIX):
        state["entry_route"] = "work"
    else:
        state["entry_route"] = "chat"
    return state

extract_menu.name: Extract menu via read_file summarization

materialize_dish_photos.name: Crop dish photos

format_chat_failure.name: Format chat failure
format_chat_failure.code:
import json


async def run(args, state):
    reason = state.get("failure_reason")
    if not isinstance(reason, str) or reason.strip() == "":
        raise ValueError("shop_menu_agent: failure_reason is required")
    sections = state.get("menu_sections")
    if sections is None:
        sections = []
    if not isinstance(sections, list):
        raise TypeError("shop_menu_agent: menu_sections must be a list")
    state["response"] = json.dumps(
        {"sections": sections, "failure_reason": reason.strip()},
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )
    return state

apply_menu.name: Complete import WorkItem
apply_menu.code:
async def run(args, state):
    job = state["shop_job"]
    response = state["response"]
    if not isinstance(response, str) or response.strip() == "":
        raise ValueError("shop_menu_agent: response JSON is required after materialize")
    await tools.work_item_complete(
        work_item_id=job["work_item_id"],
        terminal_state="completed",
        resolution_text=response,
    )
    return state

fail_job.name: Fail WorkItem
fail_job.code:
async def run(args, state):
    job = state["shop_job"]
    reason = state["failure_reason"]
    if not isinstance(reason, str) or reason.strip() == "":
        raise ValueError("shop_menu_agent: failure_reason is required to fail the WorkItem")
    await tools.work_item_complete(
        work_item_id=job["work_item_id"],
        terminal_state="failed",
        resolution_text=reason.strip(),
    )
    state["response"] = reason.strip()
    return state
